summary: This informational document describes where and how IPv6 over constrained-node networks, known as 6lo, can be used. It gives deployment examples across many link technologies, including IEEE 802.15.4, Z-Wave, Bluetooth LE, DECT-ULE, MS/TP, NFC, and power line communication. It is aimed at readers who want to understand and evaluate end-to-end IPv6 on such networks.

eli5.summary: Tiny gadgets like light switches and sensors also want to join the internet. This guide shows the different ways they can, depending on whether they talk by radio, power wire, or touch.

questions: ipv6 over bluetooth le and z-wave
